title: TRIA dataset metadata schema, TRIA dataset files
description: Schema for main dataset-related data in TRIA dataset files

ds_label.description: Unique dataset label assigned by TRIA

ds_license.description: "All rights reserved" while the dataset is embargoed

url.description: URL of the dataset landing page in the TRIA web app

doi.description: DOI of the dataset, if registered

citation.description: Citation of the dataset, with the DOI if registered, otherwise with the url
